audience: HR teams that run onboarding and employee journeys with Enboarder

useCases.title: See which workflows exist
useCases.text: List the workflows and read the properties of one. Check the fields that a launch needs.

useCases.title: Review the data of a workflow
useCases.text: Read the data of launched workflows, or list the launched instances of one workflow by its id.

useCases.title: Read form submissions
useCases.text: List the forms and read the submissions of one form.

useCases.title: Start onboarding for a new hire
useCases.text: Launch a workflow for a new employee with the person data.

useCases.title: Correct or stop a running workflow
useCases.text: Update the data of a running workflow, or cancel it if the hire does not start.
